name: Pellagra
advice: Eat protein-rich food daily (pulses, eggs, milk, groundnuts, meat) and stop alcohol. Protect exposed skin from sun until healed. Tell us about medicines like isoniazid, azathioprine or 5-FU; tests: CBC, LFT, albumin; urinary 5-HIAA if carcinoid suspected.
